query_response.title: The Project Pour
method: Choose one milestone that defines useful progress.
Break it into actions small enough to finish this week.
Review what moved and choose the next action.

response.title: The Project Measure
method: Pick one milestone that would demonstrate progress.
Divide it into steps you can complete this week.
Review what moved forward and select the next step.

response.title: The Restful Measure
method: Choose one bedtime that works for the week.
Break the evening into small calming actions.
Review what helped and adjust the next night.

response.title: The Clear Conversation
method: State the issue without blame.
Listen before replying.
Agree one next step.

response.title: The Climate Compass
method: Treat weather as today's outfit and climate as the whole wardrobe.
Use a forecast for weather and decades of records for climate.

response.title: The Polite Decline
method: Thank them for the invitation.
Decline directly without overexplaining.
Offer another date only if you mean it.

response.title: The Budget Balance
method: List essential monthly costs.
Set a realistic flexible allowance.
Move savings after payday.

rationale: The target shares distinctive project substance; the hard distractor shares recipe structure and generic progression but changes the task.

query_response.title: The Interview Infusion
method: Research the role and choose three examples that show relevant skills.
Practise each example as a short situation, action, and result.
Finish with one question that shows genuine curiosity.
query_response.garnish: A slow breath before the first answer.

response.title: The Candidate Infusion
method: Study the role and select three examples of the skills it needs.
Rehearse each as situation, action, and result.
Close with a question driven by real curiosity.

response.title: The Presentation Infusion
method: Research the audience and choose three points that serve their needs.
Practise each point as a short claim, example, and implication.
Finish by inviting one useful question.
response.garnish: A slow breath before the first slide.

response.title: The Debugging Dash
method: Reproduce the problem consistently.
Change one variable at a time.
Record the result before the next test.

response.title: The Friendly First Step
method: Open with something shared in the moment.
Ask a question that invites more than yes or no.
Listen for the next thread.

response.title: The Learning Loop
method: Study one concept briefly.
Close the notes and recall it.
Review again after a growing interval.

response.title: The Weekend Wander
method: Pick one area rather than crossing the whole city.
Mark two places and leave room to wander.
Check the journey home before setting out.

rationale: The target is a near reproduction of interview-specific content; the hard distractor deliberately mirrors wording and structure for another task.
